sentences.en: Yanni put the phone underneath his clothes and stole it.
sentences.zh: 亚尼把手机塞在衣服下面偷走了。

sentences.en: A voluminous robe hid the contours of the body underneath.
sentences.zh: 宽松的大袍子遮住了身体下面的轮廓。

sentences.en: A sociopath is charming on the surface and evil underneath.
sentences.zh: 一个反社会人格者表面上很迷人，实际上却很邪恶。

senses.zh: 在…的下面；在…的形式下；在…的支配下
